dataset.title: Claims in Danish register-data economics papers
dataset.author: Johanna Einsiedler
dataset.citation: Johanna Einsiedler (2026). Claims in Danish register-data economics papers (version 1) [Data set]. Metalens. https://metalens.tech/dataset?id=6d23ec08-85a5-471a-93d5-a8edc1aae41e
dataset.description: The claims stated in the abstracts of 244 economics papers that use Danish register data, each linked to the regression estimates that test it, grouped into estimands with one main estimate each. Imported from run 1 of the danish-register-econ agent pipeline (Claude Opus 5; protocols stated claims v2 and claim map v1). The Danish Causal Atlas draws the edge claims of this corpus as one graph.

evidence_policy.text: Quotations in these files are cut to at most 200 characters around the extracted value, with the page and the source kept: the snippet length publishers' text-and-data-mining terms allow for published output (Elsevier TDM licence). A cut end is marked with an ellipsis. The full quotations are kept with the dataset on Metalens, where its owner reviews them against the papers.
